name: herdr-world
description: A visual IDE for AI agents. Focus your attention with office, mindmaps and boards. Chat with agents, review files and changes. Play with your agents.
author: IvoryHeart

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:linux-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:darwin-x64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:darwin-arm64
scripts.build:windows-x64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:windows-x64
scripts.build:windows-arm64: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:windows-arm64
scripts.build:all: bun run build:web && bun run --filter herdr-world-server compile:all
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter herdr-world-web typecheck && bun run --filter herdr-world-server typecheck
scripts.precommit: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check: bun run notices:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:bun && bun run test && bun run build && bun run build:site && bun run spec:check
scripts.check:docs: bun run notices:check && bun run format:check && bun run build:site && bun run spec:check
scripts.clean: rm -rf web/dist server/public server/src/public-files.gen.ts server/herdr-world server/herdr-world.exe server/herdr-world.map server/herdr-world-* && bun run clean:bun-build
scripts.verification:gate: bun run verification:setup && bun run verification:typecheck && bun run verification:notices:check && bun run verification:check && bun run verification:diagnostic-control
